memory_update.text: VRT should remain the system-level reference anchor for AI data-center liquid cooling, but not the primary underfollowed alpha lane because it is high-attention and mega-cap.
MOD is a priority underfollowed-lane candidate to verify for AI/HPC data-center cooling revenue, Airedale liquid-cooling/CDU exposure, backlog conversion, and customer concentration.

NVT is a direct liquid-cooling infrastructure candidate despite its larger market cap because it explicitly offers CDUs, manifolds, rack infrastructure, PDUs, and services tied to AI-chip cooling requirements.

Need a later component-only pass for US-listed or ADR-exposed pump, valve, quick-disconnect, manifold, sensor, heat-exchanger, and thermal-interface suppliers; Parker Hannifin appears relevant but was excluded from this four-name list to preserve underfollowed capacity.

Chemours is a speculative materials-level path: include only if field trials convert into commercial immersion-cooling contracts or OEM specifications; otherwise downgrade as optionality rather than confirmed AI rack exposure.
